Augmented Reality

See the data, right on the machine

AR overlays live sensor readings, work instructions and asset health onto real equipment — so field teams inspect, maintain and get expert help faster and safer.

  • Real-time data overlays & guided maintenance
  • Remote expert collaboration & hands-free workflows
  • Faster onboarding with immersive training
MV · LV · I&C Panels

Custom power & control panels, built to standard

We design, engineer and build medium-voltage, low-voltage and instrumentation & control panels tailored to each plant — to spec, to code, and ready to commission.

  • MV switchgear, LV distribution & motor control centres
  • Instrumentation & control (I&C) panels
  • Compliant with IEC / customer standards, factory-tested

Bridging OT & IT

One vendor-agnostic architecture, field to cloud

We connect plant-floor controllers to enterprise systems with a secure, standards-based layer — so decisions are driven by live data, not guesswork.

  • SCADA, PLC & safety-system upgrades to SIL-2
  • ERP & MES integration over OPC UA / MQTT
  • Network segmentation & OT cybersecurity hardening
